name: translate-i18n-json
description: Translate i18n localization files (JSON, ARB, XML, YAML, PO, XLIFF, MD and more) with AI directly inside VS Code using l10n.dev — smart, context-aware localization powered by AI.

configuration.title: Translate i18n by l10n.dev
configuration.description: Settings for the Translate i18n files by l10n.dev extension

l10n-translate-i18n.apiKey.description: API Key for l10n.dev service (stored securely in VS Code secrets)

l10n-translate-i18n.useContractions.description: Use grammar contractions (makes translation less formal)

l10n-translate-i18n.useShortening.description: Use shortened forms if translation is longer than source text

l10n-translate-i18n.generateGlossary.description: When enabled, a glossary is generated from your source and translated target content, then saved as the active glossary for this language pair for future translations.

l10n-translate-i18n.generatePluralForms.description: Generate additional plural form strings (e.g., for i18next) with plural suffixes. Do not enable for strict source-to-target mapping.

l10n-translate-i18n.saveFilteredStrings.description: Save filtered strings (content policy violations or length limit) to a separate .filtered.json/.filtered.arb file. If disabled, filtered strings are only logged.

l10n-translate-i18n.translateMetadata.description: Translate metadata along with UI strings. For example, in Flutter ARB files, metadata entries like @key contain descriptions that can also be translated. Enable to translate metadata in target files.

l10n-translate-i18n.enableMcpServer.description: Provide the built-in l10n.dev MCP server to Chat, using the API Key stored by this extension. Disable if you prefer to configure ai-l10n-mcp manually in mcp.json.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
